title: Rebuild Lydite graphs from a clean checkout
summary: PR #22 adds pinned upstream fetch, graph rebuild, and archive and graph change checks. Its candidate checks passed and the PR remains open.
acceptance_criteria: Fetch only explicitly pinned upstream commits for the existing archive entries.
Rebuild all three historical maps on a standard public runner and check their committed bytes.
Recheck on the accepted destination commit after integration.

evidence.claim: The hardening branch checks for each pinned public AlderVale commit and fetches the missing object.
